name: SECA
description: SECA (Sovereign European Cloud API) is an open industry standard for cloud infrastructure management, developed as a building block for the EuroStack. Backed by European cloud providers including Aruba (Italy) and IONOS (Germany), the specification follows the OpenAPI Initiative's conventions to ensure broad developer trust and easy inspection.

owner.name: SECA
owner.description: Aruba, IONOS and Dynamo introduce Sovereign European Cloud API (SECA), an open industry standard and API specification for cloud infrastructure management, paving the way for the EuroStack. The specification is built and continues to evolve in line with the Open API Initiative, ensuring trust among a wide developer community and staying always open for inspection.
